definitions: Calculations or approximations made for events, conditions, or characteristics that occur with very infrequent or rare occurrence rates within a given population or dataset.
Statistical figures or projections concerning phenomena that are not widespread or common.
examples: The study relied on low-prevalence estimates to model the spread of the rare disease.
Accurate low-prevalence estimates are crucial for effective resource allocation in public health.
Researchers refined their low-prevalence estimates after collecting more data.
